map.Unix 时间戳（自 1970-01-01 起的秒/毫秒数）广泛用于日志与接口。: Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds since 1970-01-01) are widely used in logs and APIs. ToolBox Timestamp Conversion converts locally between a timestamp and a readable date, with automatic millisecond detection.
map.时间戳 → 日期：自动识别秒或毫秒: Timestamp to date: automatically detects seconds or milliseconds
map.日期 → 时间戳：生成秒级与毫秒级两种: Date to timestamp: produces both second and millisecond values
map.显示当前时间戳，一键刷新: Shows the current timestamp with one-click refresh
map.支持本地时区展示: Supports display in the local time zone
map.批量/逐个转换皆可: Handles both batch and single conversion
map.排查日志：把接口返回的时间戳还原成具体时间: Log troubleshooting: turn a timestamp returned by an API back into a concrete time
map.调试代码：确认时区与单位(秒/毫秒)是否一致: Code debugging: confirm the time zone and unit (seconds or milliseconds) agree
map.查看当前时间戳作为参照: Check the current timestamp as a reference
map.在\"转日期\"框粘贴时间戳，自动判断秒/毫秒并显示日期: Paste a timestamp into the "to date" box; seconds or milliseconds are detected automatically and the date is shown
map.在\"转时间戳\"框选择日期时间，生成对应秒/毫秒值: Pick a date and time in the "to timestamp" box to generate the matching second or millisecond value
map.注意结果所在的时区是否为你预期: Check that the time zone of the result is the one you expect
map.复制需要的值用于代码或文档: Copy the value you need for code or documentation
map.最常见坑：把毫秒当秒用会差 1000 倍，工具会自动识别但请复核: The most common trap: treating milliseconds as seconds is off by a factor of 1000. The tool detects this automatically, but double-check.
map.前后端约定好单位，避免前端用秒、后端用毫秒: Agree the unit between front end and back end so one does not use seconds while the other uses milliseconds
map.涉及展示时统一用用户本地时区，存储用 UTC: Use the user's local time zone for display and store in UTC
map.秒和毫秒怎么区分？: How do I tell seconds from milliseconds?
map.13 位通常是毫秒，10 位是秒；本工具会尝试自动判断。: 13 digits usually means milliseconds and 10 digits means seconds; this tool tries to detect it automatically.
map.为什么不同机器显示时间不同？: Why do different machines show different times?
map.因为时区设置不同，底层时间戳是一致的。: Because the time zone settings differ; the underlying timestamp is the same.
